# GSPTeck

> GSPTeck is giosaia's indie studio. It builds mobile and web apps with Flutter and Firebase.

GSPTeck is run by one developer, giosaia. Official Android apps are published on Google Play under the developer name GSPTeck, with package names that start with com.gspteck.

Contact the studio at themaker@gspteck.com. Official social accounts are @giosaia on X (https://x.com/giosaia) and Instagram (https://instagram.com/giosaia). Source code is at https://github.com/gspteck.

Website setup is a GSPTeck service: €50 for a single-page site or €200 for a multi-page site, then €55 per year all-inclusive (hosting and domain). These prices are final; no tax is added.

## Official products and sites

- [CoinDrop](https://coindrop.website): Android app for crypto airdrops, community tasks and daily rewards on Solana (Google Play: com.gspteck.coindrop)
- [Swappr](https://swappr.website): Android app to swap one crypto coin for another (Google Play: com.gspteck.swappr)
- [IOU](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gspteck.iou): Android app to track money you owe and money owed to you (Google Play: com.gspteck.iou)
- Random Number Generator: simple Android utility, published on Google Play as com.gspteck.randomnumbergenerator
- TuneBinder: Android app, published on Google Play as com.gspteck.tunebinder
- SnakeGame: classic snake game clone, listed on the [GSPTeck homepage](https://gspteck.com/) (Unity)
- [Auto X](https://autox.network): Telegram bot that schedules and publishes posts on X (@auto_x_schedule_bot)
- [CoinX](https://coinx.gspteck.com): hub for GSPTeck's crypto projects and guides
- [PilotaSEO](https://pilotaseo.com): done-for-you SEO blog service in English and Italian
